verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own API Platform covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data, a full-lifecycle Boleto API, and an MCP server that handles card management, vendor bill pay, reimbursements and statements 'without opening the Jeeves app'. However, nothing claims full UI parity, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent. Probes found no public OpenAPI spec to confirm breadth. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for team/role/permission management, Jeeves Cash FX conversion and account management, and expense policy configuration, plus a published OpenAPI spec and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: API Platform: Developer APIs for cards, payments, transactions, and expense data.
The Boleto API supports the full boleto lifecycle, enabling clients to create, retrieve, extend, and cancel boletos via secure integration.
ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, or submit a reimbursement, all without opening the Jeeves app.
Manage cards — list and filter company cards, issue new virtual cards, update names, spending limits, and reset intervals.
Pay vendors and handle bills — review bill pay invoices, manage vendors and their payment details
